title: The Animal Remains
overview: Mira and her dog Baxus live a peaceful and isolated life in the countryside, until one day they witness a shocking event. After intervening in a sexual assault in the woods near their house, they are forced to face the aftermath. Mira embarks on a transformative journey through the complexities of the justice system until the lines between humanity and nature blur irrevocably.
